sources.title: FluidAudio - Swift Package Registry
sources.snippet: The SDK includes state-of-the-art speaker diarization, transcription, and voice activity detection via open-source models (MIT/Apache 2.0) that can be integrated with just a few lines of code. Models are optimized for background processing, ambient computing and always on workloads by running inference on the ANE, minimizing CPU usage and avoiding GPU/MPS entirely.

sources.title: pyannoteAI ⎮Speaker Diarization & Conversation Intelligence
sources.snippet: pyannoteAI is a speaker intelligence platform that processes conversational audio to identify who spoke when (providing best-of-breed speaker diarization), separate overlapping voices, and provide structured speaker metadata for downstream applications.
